title: Annotatio IV §.IX close: Augustine (5) — unworthy excluded; disciples ate the Lord, Judas the Lord’s bread — stop before §.X
pass_a_gloss: Also (5) with exclusion of participation of Christ’s Body as concerns the unworthy, i.e. the Impenitent and unbelieving. For so he expressly discriminates between the eating of Christ’s believing Disciples and of Judas the traitor of Christ: The Disciples, he says, were eating the bread the Lord; Judas the bread of the Lord, against the Lord (Tract. 59 on John).
pass_b_english: Augustine (5): the unworthy (impenitent, unbelieving) are excluded from participation of the Body.
Disciples ate the bread the Lord; Judas ate the Lord’s bread against the Lord (Tract. 59 on John).
Stop before §.X (sixth century onward — decline; Gelasius still holding).
source_text: Etiam (5) cum exclusione participationis Corporis Christi, quod ad indignos, i. e. Impœnitentes atq; incredulos attinet. Sic enim expressè discriminat inter manducationem credentium Christi Discipulorum, & Judæ proditoris Christi: Discipuli, ait, manducabant panem Dominum; Judas panem Domini, contra Dominum, Tract. 59. in Johannem.

lemmas.gloss: the Lord’s bread, against the Lord

choices.english: the bread the Lord … the Lord’s bread
